crossRefs.note: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
translations.bsb: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
translations.kjv: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
translations.asv: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.
